post.caption:
Nothing opens a line between you and the other end. Your message is split into packets, each carrying an address and a position, and each one is routed independently by whichever junction it reaches. Two packets from the same photo can cross different continents and arrive out of order. That was deliberate: no central point to break. The far end sorts them by number and quietly re-requests anything missing, which is why the internet degrades rather than dies.
